leadText: Kazuki Yao (Japanese: 矢尾一樹 Yao Kazuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Kazuki Yao (Japanese: 矢尾一樹 Yao Kazuki) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Yao was born on June 17, 1959, in , , . He became a voice actor as an adult and led a long, prolific voice acting career, becoming known for a variety of roles in anime series. Yao voiced one of his best-known roles as Canalave City Gym Leader Byron, during of . Azuma is currently affiliated with Max Mix.
